name: graphify-watch
description: Native VS Code file watching that triggers one-shot graphify update rebuilds, with live state in the status bar (graphifyy 0.8.36).

graphifyWatch.autoStart.description: Start the watcher automatically for each workspace folder on activation.

graphifyWatch.autoForceShrinkPercent.description: When a rebuild is refused because the new graph has fewer nodes than graph.json (shrink guard), automatically retry once with --force if the shrink is at most this percent. Set 0 to disable auto-force.

graphifyWatch.debounce.description: Debounce window in seconds. Changed files are collected and a one-shot `graphify update` runs this many seconds after the last change.

graphifyWatch.pythonPath.description: Absolute path to a Python interpreter with graphify installed. Leave empty to auto-resolve.

graphifyWatch.outDir.description: Graphify output directory relative to the workspace folder.

graphifyWatch.showNotifications.description: Show notifications for watcher errors and update-needed events.

graphifyWatch.staleLockSeconds.description: Age in seconds after which another window's .watch.lock is treated as stale.

scripts.test: tsx test/parseWatcherLine.test.ts && tsx test/flagDecision.test.ts && tsx test/pathFilter.test.ts && tsx test/runDecision.test.ts
